history_summary: Record thirteen generic genus correspondences and complete Arthrobacter alternatives for fifteen Wheat DT descriptors.
history_details: Actual native ground-and-status changed W1-W15 descriptors only: thirteen reference-genus blocks, complete eleven-option Arthrobacter sets for the distinct W3/W7 stocks, fifteen statuses and two native events. The native status command processed sixteen taxa but the unchanged W16 Ensifer ambiguity is not a new correction. Preserve all sixteen strain names and marker accessions, repeated-stock distinctions, exact quotations and current biological constraints. Generic reference populations are not sample abundances, study assemblies or verified stock identities; Bacillus4981/8737 and Pseudomonas17956/25706 are not unanimous. The source's equal-volume OD recipe and99percent16S classification do not establish strain-specific viability or endpoint dominance. Preserve wheat origin versus barley experimental host,43.3percent leaf DAF endpoint without superiority over barley/WCS417, PEG-screen versus plant-drought limits and prechallenge RNA without causal pathway assignment. Crosswalk release is unestablished; mtime is not a release. Source preparation was authored locally and actual application ran on M5 at cfa5f093. This diagnostic does not complete scientific review, references, generated products or corpus QC.
